messages:
Nina (CS): CanaryRetail POC: dedicated GPU pool in us-west2 failing during reservation step. Customer demo tomorrow morning, need help ASAP.
Evan (Sales): They asked if we can switch to another region without changing reserved pricing. Also worried about static egress.
Kai (Eng Platform): Can you paste the provisioner error?
Nina (CS): Error snippet: 
```
ReservationError: topologyConstraintViolation: unable to satisfy zoneAffinity
Cause: QuotaCheckFailed: GPU_QUOTA=0 for project=canary-retail in us-west2
Also: NetworkError: failed to allocate IPs from subnet 10.4.8.0/24
```
Marta (Infra): Two blockers: subnet /24 too small for alias IP ranges, and project GPU quota is zero. Customer likely created project without requesting GPUs.
Omar (Security): If we move region, confirm customer's KMS key location. They use CMKs. Any cross-region move requires key replication or new key in target region.
Kai (Eng Platform): Quick options: 1) ask customer to request GPU quota (may be slow), 2) provision in our managed tenancy in same region (if provider capacity exists), 3) fallback to us-east1 where quotas show available.
ops-bot: Provision attempt #3 failed at 09:12 UTC (req id prov-0c9d). Logs: https://ci.internal/prov/0c9d
Evan (Sales): Customer prefers staying in US and needs guaranteed IPs for allowlist. Will they accept us-east1 for the demo?
Nina (CS): Customer said yes to us-east for demo if we can provide static egress and ensure CMK access.
Marta (Infra): We can expose static NAT IPs from our egress pool; need approval for managed tenancy use. I'll check managed pool availability in us-east1 (ETA 15m).
Omar (Security): For CMK: either replicate key to us-east1 or have customer grant our service account decrypt permissions on the key. I'll send policy snippet.
Kai (Eng Platform): Action items: (Kai) try provisioning test pool in us-east1 dev account (ETA 40m); (Marta) confirm managed pool IPs if needed (ETA 15m); (Nina) request customer to open GPU quota ticket (we'll provide template) and confirm CMK approach.
Evan (Sales): Please flag any pricing changes.
Kai (Eng Platform): Pricing same per SKU; transient managed pool will be billed at on-demand rate with ops surcharge. Reserved discounts require commitment in contract and pre-provisioning.
Nina (CS): Customer started quota ticket and agreed to temporary us-east demo. I'll coordinate keys and allowlist.
Marta (Infra): Update: managed pool capacity in us-east1 confirmed. Will share NAT IP list after provisioning completes.
Nina (CS): Closing loop 09:48 UTC 3 provisioning in progress in us-east1; customer to test at 10:30 UTC.
